units.source_text: 虽然发生过那种事情，但他没有来信，也没有约会，更没有信守诺言送来舞蹈造型的书。

en.t: Although that had happened, he sent no letter, did not come to see her, and even failed to keep his promise to send the book on dance forms.

units.source_text: 在女子看来，准以为是他一笑了之，把自己忘了。

en.t: From the woman's point of view, she must surely have thought he had simply laughed it off and forgotten her.

units.source_text: 按理说，岛村是应该首先向她赔礼道歉或解释一番的，但岛村连瞧也没瞧她，一直往前走。

en.t: By rights, Shimamura ought first to have apologized to her or offered some explanation, but he did not even look at her and kept walking ahead.

units.source_text: 他觉察到她不仅没有责备自己的意思，反而在一心倾慕自己。

en.t: He sensed that she had no intention of reproaching him at all; on the contrary, she was wholeheartedly drawn to him.

units.source_text: 这就使他越发觉得此时自己无论说什么，都只会被认为是不真挚的。

en.t: That made him feel all the more that anything he said now would only be taken as insincere.

units.source_text: 他被她慑服了，沉浸在美妙的喜悦之中，一直到了楼梯口，

en.t: Overawed by her, he was immersed in a wonderful sweetness of joy until they reached the staircase.

units.source_text: 他才突然把左拳伸到女子的眼前，竖起食指说：

en.t: Only then did he suddenly thrust his left fist before the woman's eyes, raise his index finger, and say:
